note: Recorded evidence from the post-fix calibration comparison of 2026-08-14: one run, one Campaign, both variants, thirty-six committed tasks each, qwen/qwen3.7-flash in real Docker runtimes against a real provider. Every episode, reward, runtime record, resolved configuration and usage figure here was produced by that run. Nothing is invented and nothing is re-projected.
raw_traces_retained: The raw traces were retained for this run and their digests are in each variant's execution record, but they are not committed: they are complete subject transcripts and they carry the taskset's expected answers, so they stay local exactly as specification section 6.19 requires.
sanitization: Decision 0015 section 5. Two redactions, both applied by the re-record tool and never by hand. Every subject final reply is set to null: for a taskset scored by exact match a correct reply is the expected answer, and the candidate's were thirty-six well-formed answer tokens. The engine's resolved configuration has its absolute output and skill paths rewritten to /techtree-home, because the live ones name a username and a temporary directory. The live bytes were verified against the run's own execution record BEFORE redaction; the digests here are of the committed bytes, so the fixture is internally consistent and is not claimed to be the live record. The raw-traces digest still names the live file, which is retained outside this repository.
supersedes: The two WP6c probes of 2026-08-13 and every re-projection they needed. Those probes predated decisions 0007 R5 and R9, their raw traces were never retained, and several of their fields could only be derived rather than measured -- model_calls in particular was explicitly not a measurement. Decisions 0009 and 0012 scheduled this replacement; the fields it replaces are now measured, so the re-projection notes are gone rather than amended.
